description: Creating a site whose parent_id names no stored scope node is refused 422 Unprocessable Content / VALIDATION_FAILED, carrying SCOPE_NODE_PARENT_INVALID against `parent_id`, with no row created. The seeded tree is complete and conformant — a real org root with a real site under it — so the only thing wrong in the whole store is where this create says its parent is. The refusal is the half of DAT-002 that the deletion rules' own guard cannot reach: an absent parent is a legitimate SUBTREE BOUNDARY to a reader holding part of the tree (a relay/1 per-scope snapshot need not carry the org root, REL-065), and this surface is the authority holding all of it, where the same absence is the unresolvable reference DAT-002 forbids. `id` is omitted because a resource's own id is exclusively server-assigned (api/1 API-105).

body.title: Validation Failed
body.detail: One or more fields failed validation.

errors.message: a non-org scope node's parent_id MUST reference an existing scope node (DAT-002)
